parameters.name: CertNo
parameters.description: The ID card number.

parameters.name: CertifyId
parameters.description: The authentication ID.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, such as 2025-10-16 23:59:59.

parameters.name: HasDeviceRisk
parameters.description: Specifies whether device risk exists. Set this parameter to true to indicate root = 1, simulator = 1, or virtual_video = 1.

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: The liveness detection model.

parameters.name: OuterOrderNo
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the customer request.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: Passed
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the authentication is passed. Valid values:
- **T**: Passed.
- **F**: Not passed.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The product code.

parameters.name: RiskBizScenario
parameters.description:
The business scenario risk. Valid values:
- **0**: No risk.
- **1**: Risk exists.

parameters.name: RiskDevice
parameters.description:
The device risk. Valid values:
- **0**: No risk.
- **1**: Risk exists.

parameters.name: RiskDeviceToken
parameters.description:
The DeviceToken risk. Valid values:
- **0**: No risk.
- **1**: Risk exists.

parameters.name: RiskGeneric
parameters.description:
The generic risk. Valid values:
- **0**: No risk.
- **1**: Risk exists.

parameters.name: RiskModelMining
parameters.description:
The large model mining risk. Valid values:
- **0**: No risk.
- **1**: Risk exists.

parameters.name: Root
parameters.description: Specifies whether the device is rooted. Set this parameter to 1 if selected. Otherwise, do not pass this parameter. This corresponds to the identity tag risk type.

parameters.name: SceneId
parameters.description: The scene ID.

parameters.name: Simulator
parameters.description: Specifies whether the device is a simulator. Set this parameter to 1 if selected. Otherwise, do not pass this parameter. This corresponds to the device tag risk type.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, such as 2025-10-10 00:00:00.

parameters.name: SubCode
parameters.description: The result code. For more information about valid values, see [SubCode description](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/id-verification/financial-grade-id-verification/error-code-person-verify#d88910e172fgg).

parameters.name: SubCodes
parameters.description: Comma-separated result codes. For more information about valid values, see [SubCode description](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/id-verification/financial-grade-id-verification/error-code-person-verify#d88910e172fgg).

parameters.name: VirtualVideo
parameters.description: Specifies whether virtual video adaptation is used. Set this parameter to 1 if selected. Otherwise, do not pass this parameter. This corresponds to the behavior tag risk type.
